paite: Nuh theih mantam sang in minhoih ahoihzaw; mi pian ni sang in sih ni.
heading: Hinna Tungtang Thu Ngaihtuahnate

paite: Ankuangluina inn a hoh sang in, suunna inn a hoh ahoihzaw; huai mi tengteng tawpna ahi a; huan mihing in alungtang a angaihtuah ding ahi.
Nuih sang in lungkham ahoihzaw; mel lungkhamna ah lungtang kipahsak in lah a-om ngala.
Mipil lungtang suunna inn ah a-om; himahleh mihaite lungtang vualnopna inn ah a-om hi.
Mi a ding in mihaite lasak zak sang in, mipil taina zak ahoihzaw.
Bel nuai a lingte puak vengvung bang in, mihai nuihna huchibang in a-om ngal a; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Simmohna in mipil ahaisak mahmah a; thilpiak in theihsiamna asusia hi.
Akipatna sang in thil tawpna ahoihzaw; lungsim a kisaktheih sang in lungsim a doh theih ahoihzaw hi.
Heh ding in na lungsim in kinoh ke'n; hehna lah mihaite awm ah akhawl hi.
Nidanglaite hiaite sang a ahoihzawkna aziak bang ahia? chi ke'n; hiai thu lah pilhuaitak in na dong kei hi.
Pilna gouluah bang in ahoih a; ahi, amau ni mute a ding in ahoihzaw tham hi.
Dangka sum kihumna ahih bang in, pilna lah kihumna ahi ngal a; himahleh theihna hoihzawkna bel, pilna in aneimi hinna ahawisak hi.
Pathian nasep ngaihtuah in; ama'n akawisak sa, kua ahia bawl tang thei ding?
Hauhsak ni in nuamsa inla, huan vangtah ni in ngaihtuah in; mihing in anung a thil om ding amuhkhiaklouhna ding in, Pathian in khat lah adang kiang ah kihiang helhel in abawl hi.
Ka bangmah lou ni in hiai tengteng ka muta hi; midiktat adiktatna a mangthang a-om a, huan migilou agilou bawlna a ahinna hihsau a-om hi.
Kidiktatsak lo zen ke'n; kipilsak lo zen sam ke'n; bangziak a nang kihihse ding na hia?
Gilou lo zen ke'nla, hai sam ke'n; na hun tun ma a bangziak a si ding na hia?
Hiai na let tinten ahoih hi; ahi huai a kipan in leng na khut kai ke'n; kuapeuh Pathian kihta lah amute tengteng a kipan hong paikhe ding uh ahi ngal a.
Khopi a om vaihawmmi sawmkhat sang in mipil a ding in pilna athupizaw.
Hoih hih a, khial lou, leitung ah midiktat a-om mahmah kei hi.
Thu kigen tengteng leng limsak khol dah in; huchi lou in zaw na sikha in nang ahon hamsiat na za kha ding hi.
Na lungtang in lah huchi mah bang in nang leng midangte na hamsiat mun chih athei ngal a.
Hiai tengteng pilna in ka enchian vek a, "Ka pil ding," ka chi a; himahleh kei a kipan agamla hi.
Gamlatak a thilte leh athuk petpette; kua'n amukhe thei dia?
Ka kipumhei a, thei ding leh zongkhe ding, pilna zong ding leh thilte ziak zong ding, gitlouhna haina ahi chih thei ding, haina lungsim kimlouhna ahi chih thei ding in ka lungtang koihkip in a-om hi.

Sihna sang a khazaw tuh numei, alungtang thangte leh lente hi a, akhut henna khau hi ahi chih ka muta hi. Kuapeuh Pathian lungkimsak huai nu a pan asuakta ding a, himahleh mikhial bel athang-awk ding hi.
Ngai in, hiai ka mukhia, thugentu in achi; thil omdantak mukhe ding in thil akhat akhat ka buk hi.
Tu in leng ka zong lai a ka mu kei; pasal sangkhat lak a mitang khat ka mu, himahleh numei tengteng lak a mitang ka mu kei hi.
Ngai in, Pathian in mihing hoihtak in abawl chih, hiai kia ka mu a; himahleh bawltawm tampi azongkhia uhi.
